literature_notes: The single ledger entry (L1, PMC7175920) describes the S15ATM chimeric construct, in which the intact SIGLEC15 ectodomain is fused to the B7-H6 transmembrane domain to create a surface-displayed artificial protein. This is a domain-swap chimera, not a tag insertion: no epitope tag, fluorescent protein, transposon, or antibody-epitope sequence is inserted into the SIGLEC15 sequence at any named residue. It does not qualify under any of the permitted modalities (epitope-tag knock-in, FP fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, antibody-epitope insertion). No residue is named for a junction. A topology-derived terminal site cannot be inferred because there is no tag in the construct at all — the ectodomain itself is the functional element. With no qualifying ledger evidence, zero sites are reported.
